criteria.question: One clear focal point per beat; reading order is obvious.
Type roles are consistent; sizes respect the floor; no orphans or awkward breaks.
Layouts are intentional in every format (not stretched or cropped landscape).
Holds match reading time; rhythm varies; nothing drags or rushes.
All text is legible at delivery size with sufficient contrast.
Palette and texture follow the chosen style system and direction.
Each transition carries meaning or continuity; none are decorative filler.
Motion vocabulary is consistent across scenes.
No repetitive looping filler or motion without purpose.
No unintended static stretches; intentional holds are marked.
No accidental overlaps, clipping or safe-area violations.
Clear opening, progression and ending; the last frame holds long enough.

pass_rule: Every criterion scored 1-5 with evidence (frame or contact-sheet paths); all >= 3 and mean >= 3.5.
